issue_title: Refine keyboard navigation for filter chips in the issue board
issue_description: The issue board supports arrow navigation, but focus can get trapped after removing a selected chip. Update the React components so keyboard users can move through filters smoothly.

issue_title: Add a first-time contributor setup guide for local development
issue_description: New contributors struggle to get the handbook site running locally. Add a concise setup guide covering Node, preview commands, and the docs review flow.

issue_title: Expose rate-limit headers on the metrics endpoint
issue_description: The metrics API already computes rate-limit information internally, but the response does not include standard limit headers. Surface the headers and update tests.

issue_title: Improve dataset loader defaults for the text classification demo
issue_description: The demo loader assumes one dataset layout and breaks when validation files are missing. Add fallback behavior and clearer inline docs for expected CSV fields.

issue_title: Add JWT audience validation regression tests
issue_description: A recent auth refactor loosened audience validation on JWT tokens. Add regression coverage and document expected behavior for shared test fixtures.

issue_title: Make parser error messages more actionable in the CLI
issue_description: The CLI currently reports generic parser failures. Improve TypeScript diagnostics so contributors can see which config field failed and where to fix it.

issue_title: Fix focus persistence in the inline grid cell editor
issue_description: After editing a grid cell, focus jumps back to the page root instead of the next cell. Preserve focus order and add a small test around the bug.

issue_title: Add a Docker healthcheck for the worker container
issue_description: The worker sometimes starts without a healthy Redis connection, and the container still reports ready. Add a Docker healthcheck and update compose docs.

issue_title: Document local cache flags for embedding runs
issue_description: The CLI supports multiple cache-related flags, but the docs do not explain how they affect repeated embedding runs. Add examples and clarify expected output.

issue_title: Validate CSV schemas before ingestion starts
issue_description: Ingestion errors currently surface midway through a run when column order is wrong. Validate incoming CSV headers early and report actionable mismatch details.

issue_title: Port the token picker panel from JavaScript to TypeScript
issue_description: The editor still ships one legacy JavaScript panel that blocks stricter type checks. Port it to TypeScript and preserve the current editor API.

issue_title: Add retry jitter configuration to the webhook dispatcher
issue_description: The dispatcher uses exponential backoff but cannot configure jitter, which leads to retry spikes under load. Add a jitter setting and extend the retry tests.

issue_title: Clarify secret scanning exclusions in the contributor docs
issue_description: Contributors are unsure how to exclude local test fixtures from secret scans without weakening defaults. Update the docs with safe examples and caveats.

issue_title: Add unit tests for entity span merge edge cases
issue_description: Entity spans that partially overlap can merge incorrectly when label confidence is tied. Add targeted tests and document the expected merge rule.

issue_title: Automate good-first-issue label sync for new parser tickets
issue_description: Parser issues tagged as onboarding-friendly should automatically receive the good-first-issue label. Add a small automation script and docs for maintainers.

issue_title: Investigate LRU eviction behavior under multithreaded load
issue_description: The cache occasionally evicts a recently touched entry when multiple threads update the access queue at once. Reproduce the bug and propose a contained fix.

issue_title: Expose failed build trend data through a new REST endpoint
issue_description: The frontend can already chart failed builds if the API exposes a rolling trend payload. Add the endpoint, tests, and a short schema note for client teams.

issue_title: Fix broken anchor links in generated API reference pages
issue_description: Several generated reference pages create anchors with duplicated slugs, which breaks deep links from the sidebar. Patch the slug generation and verify a few known pages.

issue_title: Add a cleanup job for stale self-hosted runners
issue_description: Offline GitHub runners accumulate over time and confuse the deployment UI. Add a scheduled cleanup command and document the recommended cadence.

issue_title: Suggest likely column types in the profiling report
issue_description: Profiling reports currently show raw values only. Add heuristic column type suggestions for numeric, categorical, and datetime fields, with a small test matrix.

issue_title: Document pagination conventions for the public API
issue_description: Different endpoints describe pagination differently, which creates confusion for contributors and SDK maintainers. Add a single source of truth and update the examples.
